title: Wide-Throat Library Book Return Cabinet
description: One original static library book-return cabinet, counted as one complete prop. A newly authored continuous thick shell encloses one full collection chamber with a true 0.51 by 0.16 m horizontal front throat. A projecting fixed staging ledge seats below the open throat; a separate recessed rear closure panel has real perimeter relief and a broad grounded plinth supports the shell and panel. Four complete editable closed meshes, four opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up, front -Y and plinth-centred ground origin. No books, existing counter, book cart, old model fragments, logos, images or text are included. Distinct from the existing wheeled sorting cart, front-open bookcase, four-compartment locker and arched postal letterbox with a blind recess. Fixed visual geometry only: no book compatibility, insertion or dropping simulation, borrowing system, door movement, capacity, sealing, human suitability, accessibility, stability, load, manufacture, installation or security/safety certification.
